gateAccepted: The required maintenance behavior-evidence activity has actual valid paired captures and an independent, criterion-complete assessment. This accepts those bytes as scoped development evidence; it does not certify every criterion met or select an overall winner.
independence: Reviewer distinct from both response producers; prior source/version knowledge means not blind. Both individual records frozen before this comparison.

integrity.limitations: Transcript command scope is observed, not OS read confinement; complete text read or unrecorded actions are not inferred.

actualCapture.modelSelection: gpt-5.6-terra via identical pinned wrapper, local codex-cli0.154.0, ignored user config/defaults
actualCapture.modelServerIdentityAndReasoningEffort: Not independently exposed; actual argv reconstructed, not observed live.
actualCapture.sample: One pair, six fictional-input cases in one shared context per variant.

comparisons.outcome: Both preserve attributed uninspected component evidence/local-draft/deployed gap. A explicitly records request-local label and a remaining authorized deployed-test next action; B omits restating the label and has no concrete next action.

Both retain full review open/blocked and missing environment/task/artifact/invocation without carrying case01 label. B explicitly names QA-DEMO-202; A gives explicit authorized owner/operator plus pass/fail handoff. B names inputs and expected checks but not a responsible supplier.

Both produce reusable local drafts rather than QA closeout or actual Testmo identity. B makes the result-ID assertions [A1]/[] explicit and uses compact field formatting. Both distinguish drafts from execution.

Both honor explicit workflow visibility, report full review unable to run and keep missing prerequisites. B names ticket-acceptance and clearly states blockage alone does not change the selected intent; A likewise ties any changed workflow to a changed deliverable. Neither claims evaluator execution or supported proposed families.

Both correctly attribute checkout failure/control against separate fictional intent, retain unknown severity scale/causal/freshness/persistence gaps and propose authorized independent reproduction. Neither fully separates all five requested judgment dimensions. B leaves user/business impact implicit and omits fix priority/priority-decision ownership; A explicitly leaves priority to product/delivery ownership but impact/severity are incomplete.
Both leave the low-harm control question unresolved without an approved expectation, name the product question, and do not accept defect/improvement/no-action decisions or fabricate a reproduction.

variant-a.rationale: Affected buyer/build/environment and ordinary-path reachability are explicit; severity-scale gap retained, priority left to product/delivery ownership. User/business impact and a separate qualitative severity assessment are not fully expressed.

variant-b.rationale: Outcome and deployed/raw-evidence gaps are clear, but no concrete handoff next action is stated.
Missing inputs and expected checks are explicit, but no authorized supplier/operator owner is assigned. Pass behavior is stated; failure is its converse.

Candidate/persona/environment, ordinary-flow reachability and missing severity scale explicit. User/business impact is left implicit and fix priority/priority decision ownership is absent; reproduction owner is a different decision.

claimsWithheld: Overall superiority or universal improvement from one pair.
Cross-model/host portability, effective server identity, native subagents/forge/general QA capability.
Actual fictional product execution, canonical QA acceptance/task completion, current source preservation.
Independent V3 live argv/process observation; historical V2 live observations remain historical.
Final clean source/package/main compatibility or product smoke readiness.
coverageLimits: No positive generic product QA control ran in these response trials. Finite-policy actual runtime proof remains separate.
Nearby-owner case covers reusable case authoring, not planning/triage execution or owner handoff runtime.
Opted-in/static no-visibility cases observed; no multi-turn live workflow switch was exercised.
Supplied request-local label remains fictional; no real tracker membership verification.
One shared context per variant; no per-case-fresh-model-context, repeatability or statistical claim.
requiredCarryForward: Copy the individual assessments, gaps, raw capture pins and limits into the version-controlled trial record without relabeling partial criteria as met.
Preserve invalid V2 and its preparation conflict separately; do not incorporate it as a valid comparison or rewrite outputs.
Root must prove final clean selected-resource equivalence, account current main changes, package/source gates and separately scoped actual smoke before delivery.
